theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (j : Fin ℓ) (r : Rn n), (∀ v : Rn n, inner ℝ r v = D v j) → (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint r 0))
